answer: Continuous audio-presence challenge. Each identity must answer random live prompts with a fresh spoken phrase within seconds; agents lacking genuine ambient context fail. To enroll, an operator records a unique room tone and a nectar of background noise signature, then must wander across many distinct acoustic environments over weeks to keep the profile valid. The plume of verified samples expires unless refreshed. Attacker cost: one physical microphone per identity plus real human time in varied locations, defeating cheap mass registration.
